title: Return of Premium Surrender Value — Asset-Based Long-Term Care Life Insurance
content:
# Surrender of an Ashgrove CareAssure policy for its return of premium value

**Rule.** The owner of an Asset-Based Long-Term Care Life Insurance policy may surrender it for its return of premium value. A surrender is processed only on a surrender request signed by the owner and by any irrevocable beneficiary. The value is the return of premium vesting share for the policy year of surrender times the premiums paid, less the long-term care benefits paid, never below zero, rounded to the cent. A policy with benefits being paid, exhausted or on the shortened benefit period cannot be surrendered for value.

**Definitions.**

- *Premiums paid* — the total of the remittances applied as premium on the policy from the issue date to the evaluation date, less any premium refunded as overpayment.
- *Benefits paid* — the total of the long-term care benefits paid from the acceleration pool on the policy from the issue date to the evaluation date.
- *Vesting share* — the share of premiums paid set for the policy year in which the policy is surrendered; the last share in the tier's ladder applies to every later policy year.

**The value, as a definition.** The surrender value is the vesting share multiplied by premiums paid, less benefits paid, that difference rounded to the cent; where the rounded difference is below zero the value is zero.

**Status.** A surrender for value is open to a policy that is In Force, in its Grace Period or Paid Up; it is not open to a policy that is Claim Active, Benefits Exhausted or on the Shortened Benefit period. The surrender takes effect on the date the signed surrender request was received, the policy becomes Surrendered and the value is paid, recorded with the vesting share applied.

**Signatures (truth table)**

| Signed by the owner | Irrevocable beneficiary named | Signed by that beneficiary | Processed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | — | Yes |
| Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Yes | Yes | No | No |
| No | — | — | No |

**Worked values (hypothetical policies; CareAssure vesting shares 0.80, 0.85, 0.90, 0.95 in policy years 1 to 4 and 1.00 thereafter)**

| Policy year of surrender | Premiums paid | Vesting share | Share of premiums | Benefits paid | Surrender value |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | $30000.00 | 0.90 | $27000.00 | $0.00 | $27000.00 |
| 2 | $12345.67 | 0.85 | $10493.8195 | $0.00 | $10493.82 |
| 7 | $40000.00 | 1.00 | $40000.00 | $15500.00 | $24500.00 |
| 4 | $30000.00 | 0.95 | $28500.00 | $31000.00 | $0.00 |
